rfqRoute: A buyer searching for a custom packaging company should first separate supplier fit from price comparison.
The useful RFQ should define product category, box or bag structure, size, quantity range, artwork status, finish direction and target market.
If the buyer is comparing a manufacturer, supplier, trading company or design vendor, route them to the supplier-fit guide before the contact form.
For regulated or certificate-related searches, do not assume compliance; ask for target market and document review requirements case by case.
After this route is published, evaluate the supplier-selection segment with GA4 key events, Ads search terms and GSC query/page movement.
